## Facilities Columns  
The facilities list currently renders as a single column ul. Rebalance items into two columns with more even visual spacing. Pair shorter items with longer ones to avoid uneven gaps. Use CSS columns or a two-column grid. Suggested split:

Left column:
- Wifi throughout
- Main lecture room for up to 30 people with AV facilities
- 4 break-out rooms for smaller groups
- BBQ and pizza oven
- A range of experiential activities involving nursery work or tree planting available upon request

Right column:
- Open plan kitchen and common room for onsite catering with tea and coffee-making facilities, microwave, fridge and oven
- Covered verandah with sea views to take time out or run sessions outside
- 3 wheelchair-accessible toilets/bathrooms
- Wheelchair access throughout
- Ample on-site parking

But the key is to make the visual spacing look even between items in both columns.
